exercises.title: Define connectedness by separations
exercises.objective: Rule out a disjoint covering pair of nonempty open sets.

exercises.title: Classify standard finite spaces
exercises.objective: Show Sierpiński space connected and discrete Bool disconnected.
success: connectedness applies to arbitrary open pairs

exercises.title: Connect clopen sets and continuous images
exercises.objective: Relate separation to clopen sets and use inverse images for continuous maps.

checks.lean: example {α : Type*} (τ : LeanCraftGame.Topology.MyTopology α) (h : T13.MyConnected τ) (U V : Set α) (hU : τ.IsOpen U) (hV : τ.IsOpen V) (hc : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (hd : U ∩ V = ∅) : U = ∅ ∨ V = ∅ := h U V hU hV hc hd
checks.message: Your predicate must apply directly to every disjoint open covering pair.

checks.lean:
example : T13.MyConnected LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski := by
  intro U V hU hV hc hd
  rw [LeanCraftGame.Topology.sierpinski_isOpen_iff] at hU hV
  rcases hU with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hV with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all [Set.ext_iff]
checks.message: Sierpiński space has no disjoint pair of nonempty opens covering Bool.

checks.lean:
example : ¬ T13.MyConnected (LeanCraftGame.Topology.discrete Bool) := by
  intro h
  have hs := h {true} {false} trivial trivial (by ext b; cases b <;> simp) (by simp)
  rcases hs with ht | hf
  · have hx : true ∈ ({true} : Set Bool) := rfl
    rw [ht] at hx
    exact hx
  · have hx : false ∈ ({false} : Set Bool) := rfl
    rw [hf] at hx
    exact hx
checks.message: The two singleton clopen sets separate discrete Bool.

checks.lean: example {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] [PreconnectedSpace α] (f : α → β) (hf : Continuous f) : IsPreconnected (f '' Set.univ) := isPreconnected_univ.image f hf.continuousOn
checks.message: Continuous images of preconnected spaces are preconnected.

steps: Quantify two sets `U,V`. Require openness, `U ∪ V = univ`, and `U ∩ V = ∅`.
hints.hint: Conclude `U = ∅ ∨ V = ∅`; do not require both to be empty.
